preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner to call the rebase() function
rewardsPool address must be set (not address(0)) before calling rebase()

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call the rebase() function with a very large multiple value (e.g., 10^18 or higher). This will multiply rebaseMultiple to an extremely large number, causing all balanceOf() and transfer calculations to return 0 due to division by the large rebaseMultiple. This effectively halts all token transactions. The attack sequence is: 1) Ensure rewardsPool is set via setRewardsPool(), 2) Call rebase() with a large multiple value, 3) Verify transactions are blocked by attempting a transfer.
